warnings: B4 and B4X's boxed cross-sections (cut '4-4' and '4X-4X') both show a plain (not mixed-diameter) 3-bar face -- unlike B3's family, these are straight 3-Ø16 counts, no Ø12 mixed in.

B5's box is not paired with an elevation on this sheet; it also carries a distinct '2-Ø12มม. ยาว 3.00 ม. เสริมพิเศษกลางคาน' (special 2-Ø12, 3.00m long, mid-beam) note -- recorded in additional_bars since it is not part of either main face (matches the schema's genuine-extra-bar case, not a curtailed main-face bar).
B5's stirrup spacing digit read at native resolution (150mm), not independently re-zoomed -- slightly lower confidence than the B4/B4X cross-sections which were re-verified.
